## Discrete aggregate {#sec-aggregate-discrete}

*This is a recipe for* a fully discrete compound distribution — discrete frequency × discrete severity. Because both parts are exact, so is the result: the ideal first sight of the FFT machinery, with nothing to blame on discretization.

```{python}
from _setup import *
```

```{python}
pp('agg Dice dfreq [1:6] dsev [1:6]')   # sum of a die-many dice
```

```{python}
dice = build('agg Dice dfreq [1:6] dsev [1:6]')
show(dice)
```
